name: Turkish Karnıyarık Beef-Stuffed Eggplants with Rice

components.name: Beef-Stuffed Eggplants
steps: Preheat oven to 205 C. Peel eggplants in alternating stripes, slit lengthwise almost to each end and brush with olive oil and a pinch of salt. Roast about 25-30 minutes until soft enough to open.
Meanwhile sauté onion, garlic and peppers in oil, then add beef and brown, breaking up the mince. Add chopped tomatoes, tomato paste, cumin, paprika and salt and reduce to a moist filling.
Gently open the slit in each eggplant and spoon an equal amount of the beef mixture into the cavity.
Whisk the additional tomato paste with hot water. Pour around eggplants and bake another 20-25 minutes so sauce reduces and flavours meld.
Serve each stuffed eggplant with one sixth of rice and spooned baking sauce; finish with parsley.

components.name: Basmati Rice
steps: Rinse and cook the dry rice separately with measured water, then allow to rest, covered, before fluffing.
